question: At each basketball practice last week, Jenny made twice as many free throws as she made at the previous practice. At her fifth practice she made \(48\) free throws. How many free throws did she make at the first practice?
solution:
Each practice doubles the previous count, so moving backward one practice halves the count. From the fifth practice to the first there are four backward steps. The counts, read backward, are
\[48,\quad24,\quad12,\quad6,\quad3.\]
Thus Jenny made \(\boxed{3}\) free throws at her first practice, choice \(\text{A}\).
